messages.name: DllForm_infoL
messages.explanation: Text displayed at the top of the dll file list in the 'Add dll mod' dialog box. This is for mods like Seamless Coop and RandomizerHelper. The second sentence has technical requirements for the mods - it must export a Windows function called DirectInput8Create, to act like a system dll called dinput8.dll. Some dll mods can't be activated immediately when the game loads so they require delayed initialization, but this is *not* supported by the randomizer launcher. Finally, the last sentence refers to manual Mod Engine installation, described on the mod page, where someone launches the game from Mod Engine and not from randomizer. In that case, they have to edit the Mod Engine toml file to load the dll mods, because this UI only works if randomizer launches it.
messages.english_text: These dll mods are automatically loaded when "Launch Elden Ring" is used. They must implement DirectInput8Create and not require any initialization delay. To load dlls with manual Mod Engine, instead add them to external_dlls in the toml file.
messages.text: ここに追加した DLL Mod は、"ELDEN RING を起動" を選んだときに自動で読み込まれます。DirectInput8Create を実装 + 初期化時の遅延を要さない DLL Mod のみ追加できます。Mod Engine を介して手動で読み込むなら、toml ファイルの external_dlls に追加してください。

messages.name: EldenForm_deathless
messages.explanation: Checkbox in item logic which changes how item randomizer calculates key item locations. When checked, the entire randomizer can be completed without any mandatory deaths (aside from tutorial boss). The most important change is Drawing-Room Key (客間の鍵) won't be placed in Volcano Manor, which requires dying to the Abductor Virgin at the bottom of Raya Lucaria to reach Volcano Manor. 'Routing' is a term from speedrunning which means the order or strategy you use for completing the game.

messages.name: EldenForm_deathlessL

Also has a note for an enemy randomizer change, described on the mod page, where the Abductor Virgin (人さらいの乙女人形) at the bottom of the Raya Lucaria elevator is no longer required to do the warp. You just have to die from it or die nearby it (e.g. by falling to your death)
messages.english_text: Exclude Volcano Manor abduction from logic. Note the abduction is always possible in enemy randomizer by dying nearby the abductor replacement.
messages.text: 火山館までさらわれなくてもルートを進行できるようにします。なお、人さらい自体は敵をランダム化している場合でも、乙女人形の場所に配置された敵の近くで死ぬことで必ず発生させることができます。

messages.name: EldenForm_deathlessL
messages.explanation: Further explanation for deathless option (see above), for reaching Volcano Manor (火山館). You just have to die from it or die nearby it (e.g. by falling to your death). This changed in v0.12 to remove the abduction mechanic, not just make it optional.
messages.english_text: Remove Volcano Manor abduction. Otherwise, it may be required, and is possible in enemy randomizer by dying nearby the abductor replacement.
messages.text: 火山館までさらわれなくなります。無効にした場合、さらわれなければルートが進行しないことがあります。なお、敵をランダム化していても乙女人形の代わりの敵の近くで死ねば、さらわれます

messages.name: EldenForm_randomaniaL
messages.explanation: Further explanation for RandoMania item placement, listing 2 changes in the option. First, RandoMania mode avoids placing Great Runes past Mountaintops in some circumstances, so there's more opportunity to find them earlier. Second, it adds more possible locations for Bell Bearings which normally appear in Altus Plateau. Normally, the randomizer will always keep all Bell Bearings in their vanilla areas, and Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] and Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] will always be placed in Altus Plateau, usually dropping from Elemer. This second option allows these Bell Bearings to appear in Volcano Manor for balance reasons. It's not necessary to write any detail about this since the event competitors already know what it means.

messages.name: EldenForm_royalaccess
messages.explanation: Checkbox in item logic which doesn't remove the graces from Leyndell, Royal Capital (王都ローデイル) after defeating Maliketh (黒き剣のマリケス), allowing Royal Capital and Ashen Capital to coexist

messages.explanation: Further explanation for royalaccess which explains the randomizer logic change. An unmissable item is an item, like a key item or bell bearing, which is not allowed to be placed in a missable location. Because Royal Capital graces don't disappear, they are no longer missable locations.
messages.english_text: Allow more Leyndell locations to have unmissable items
messages.text: 取り逃し不可の必須アイテムが、ローデイルのより多くの場所に配置されます

messages.name: EldenForm_runereq
messages.explanation: When checked, shows the message 'You require more Great Runes' when you try to access Radagon
messages.english_text: Require all 7 Great Runes to access the final boss
messages.text: ラスボスとの対決に七つすべての大ルーンを要求

messages.name: EldenForm_runereqL
messages.explanation: Further explanation for runereq. You must find the rune items, but you don't need to go to Divine Towers to make them equippable
messages.english_text: Activating the Great Runes is not required
messages.text: 大ルーンの力を取り戻す必要はありません

messages.name: EldenForm_runError
messages.explanation: Generic randomizer error, {0} is the detailed error message. Also points the user to the spoiler_logs directory
messages.english_text:
Error encountered: {0}
It may work to try again with a different seed. See most recent file in spoiler_logs directory for the full error.
messages.text:
エラー発生: {0}
このままでは動作しない恐れがあります。シードを変更してみてください。エラーの詳細については spoiler_logs ディレクトリの最新ファイルから確認できます。

messages.name: EldenForm_runErrorGeneric
messages.explanation: Shown in the status bar when miscalleneous pre-randomization errors occur
messages.text: エラー発生

messages.explanation: Shown in the status bar when randomizer files for any reason. {0} is a file name in the spoiler_logs directory

messages.text: エラー発生！ spoiler_logs ディレクトリの {0} に部分的なログを記録

messages.name: EldenForm_runes_endL
messages.explanation: Label which appears after a dropdown with values from 0-7. It describes the count of how many Great Runes are required to enter the Erdtrefe, previously the runereq option
messages.english_text: Great Runes to access the final boss
messages.text: 最終ボスと戦うための必要大ルーン数

messages.name: EldenForm_runes_leyndellL
messages.explanation: Label which appears after a dropdown with values from 0-7. It describes the count of how many Great Runes are required to remove the golden seal before Leyndell, which is normally 2.
messages.text: ローデイルに入るための必要大ルーン数

messages.name: EldenForm_runes_rold
messages.explanation: Checkbox to enable the 'Great Runes to enter Mountaintops' input. Normally you must find the medallion (ロルドの割符) to enter Mountaintops. With this option, you must instead find 0-7 Great Runes according to configuration.
messages.english_text: Replace Rold Medallion with Great Runes requirement
messages.text: ロルドの割符の代わりに大ルーンを必須にする

messages.name: EldenForm_runes_roldL
messages.explanation: Label which appears after numeric input with values from 0-7. When enabled, it requires the given number of Great Runes to use Rold Medallion to reach Mountaintops of the Giants and beat the game.
messages.text: 山嶺に入るための必要大ルーン数

messages.name: EldenForm_runes_roldL2
messages.explanation: [obsolete] Further label for the runes_rold dropdown, which indicates that Rold Medallion is no longer required to use Grand Lift of Rold and that the player should not try to search for it if they are using this feature. If there's not enough space, the 'only Great Runes' part is not as important
messages.english_text: If selected, Rold Medallion is not required, only Great Runes
messages.text: ロルドの割符が不要となり、大ルーンが求められます

messages.name: EldenForm_runesGroup
messages.explanation: Label for logic settings to change the number of Great Runes required to pass certain points in the game (大ルーン)
messages.text: 大ルーン

messages.name: EldenForm_runExtractWarning
messages.explanation: Warning message that shows up as a popup after clicking Randomize and it completes. This happens in a niche case where the version of the game from the exe textbox is not the version that randomizer was built for, and randomizer knows this happens because it has some info on the data files which it expects to extract from the game directory
messages.english_text: Randomization succeeded, but the following files extracted from the game directory have unexpected contents. This version of the randomizer might be incompatible with the installed game version and might not function correctly.
messages.text: ランダム化には成功しましたが、ゲームディレクトリから展開した以下のファイルの内容が想定と異なっています。このバージョンの Randomizer は、インストールされているゲームのバージョンと互換性がなく、正しく動作しない恐れがあります。

messages.name: EldenForm_runExtractWarningTitle
messages.explanation: Title for runeExtractWarning popup message
messages.text: 想定外のゲームファイル

messages.name: EldenForm_running
messages.explanation: Text that replaces the 'Randomize' button when randomization is running
messages.text: 実行中...

messages.name: EldenForm_runSuccess
messages.explanation: Shown in the status bar when randomization finishes. {0} is a file name in the spoiler_logs directory
messages.english_text: Done! Hints and spoilers in spoiler_logs directory as {0} - Restart your game!!
messages.text: 完了しました！ spoiler_logs ディレクトリの {0} からヒントとネタバレを確認できます。ゲームを再起動しましょう！

messages.name: EldenForm_rustykey
messages.explanation: Checkbox in item logic which makes getting and using the Rusty Key (錆びた鍵) required to enter Stormveil (ストームヴィル城) as normally Gostoc allows skipping it if he's still alive
messages.english_text: Require Rusty Key to enter Stormveil
messages.text: ストームヴィル城へ入るには錆びた鍵が必要

messages.name: EldenForm_rustykeyL
messages.explanation: Further explanation for rustykey, as NPC Gostoc (門衛ゴストーク) won't show the dialogue option (正門から入りたい) without Rusty Key in inventory
messages.english_text: Gostoc won't open the main gate without the key
messages.text: 錆びた鍵がなければゴストークは正門を開けません

messages.name: EldenForm_saveOptionsFileToolStripMenuItem
messages.explanation: Action in Options menu to select a filename to store current randomizer options. These can be shared with other people.
messages.text: オプション登録ファイルのエクスポート...

messages.name: EldenForm_scaduGroup
messages.explanation: Label asking how to randomize Scadutree Fragments/Revered Spirit Ashes (影の地の加護)
messages.text: 影の地の加護のランダム化

messages.name: EldenForm_scale
messages.explanation: When checked, increases or decreases enemy stats (HP/health they have, and how much damage they deal) using scaling
messages.text: 敵の体力/ダメージを可変させる

messages.name: EldenForm_scalerandom
messages.explanation: Custom preset option which scales enemies to a random tier, rather than based on where they're placed
messages.text: 敵のステータスをランダムに可変させる

messages.name: EldenForm_scaleup
messages.explanation: Custom preset option which never scales enemies down. They either remain at their current level or are scaled up based on their destination.
messages.text: 敵のステータスを元より弱体化させない

messages.name: EldenForm_seedError
messages.explanation: Error shown in the status bar when trying to randomize with an invalid seed (not a number, too many digits, etc.)
messages.text: 無効な固定シード

messages.name: EldenForm_setOptionsStringToolStripMenuItem
messages.explanation: Action in Options menu to open OptionsForm to copy-paste a simple string with most options in the form (but not other things like presets)
messages.text: 文字列からオプションを設定

messages.name: EldenForm_shardreqL
messages.explanation: Label which appears after a dropdown with number selection. See messmershard for more details. This describes the required number of shards
messages.text: 必要となるメスメルの種火の欠片

messages.name: EldenForm_shardreqL
messages.explanation: Label for numeric input for a Meessmer Kindling Shard requirement. See messmershard for more details. This corresponds to the in-game prompt, 封印の木を焼きますか？
messages.english_text: Shards needed to burn the sealing tree
messages.text: 封印の木を焼くのに必要な欠片数

messages.name: EldenForm_shardreqL2
messages.explanation: [obsolete] Further explanation for shardreq. Messmer's Kindling is broken up into shards, and some number of them (or all of them) is needed to burn the sealing tree (kindling description: 封印の木を焼くことができる)
messages.english_text: Number of shards needed to burn the sealing tree. If not selected, all are required.
messages.text: 封印の木を焼くことができる欠片の数です。未指定なら最大数必要です

messages.name: EldenForm_snowfast
messages.explanation: When checked, this edits the map in Mountaintops of the Giants to allow skipping large amounts of it. It adds several spirit springs for Torrent and adds warp gates between near Castle Sol and near Fire Giant. The shortcuts allow going from the Grand Lift of Rold to Fire Giant in around 2 minutes
messages.english_text: Add shortcuts in Mountaintops for faster traversal
messages.text: 山嶺にショートカットを配置して早く踏破できるようにする

messages.name: EldenForm_sombermode
messages.explanation: Option which changes required amount of Smithing Stones to upgrade a weapon which uses regular Smithing Stones. Weapons which use Somber Smithing Stones are unchanged.
messages.english_text: Reduce upgrade cost for non-somber weapons
messages.text: 鍛石による強化コストを減少

messages.name: EldenForm_sombermodeL
messages.explanation: More details about sombermode. Instead of upgrades requiring 2-4-6 of any Smithing Stone, it is changed to 1-1-1 (from 97 in total, to 25 in total).
messages.english_text: Require only one Smithing Stone per weapon level
messages.text: 通常武器を 1 つの鍛石で強化可能にします

messages.name: EldenForm_specialGroup
messages.explanation: Label for Misc Options options group, to select options which change randomizer behavior for special reasons
messages.text: 特別なモード

messages.name: EldenForm_spellshops
messages.explanation: When checked, shops which normally have sorceries/incantations get random sorceries/incantations
messages.text: 術屋には術を売らせる

messages.name: EldenForm_spellshopsL
messages.explanation: Further explanation of spellshops: sorcery shops only get sorceries, and incantation shops only get incantations
messages.english_text: Place sorceries/incantations in shops of that type
messages.text: 魔術・祈祷を扱っている NPC にそれらを販売させます

messages.name: EldenForm_springseals
messages.explanation: DLC option to randomize which seal unlocks which spiritspring. They're described in this item sold by Moore: 拾い虫たちが拾ってきた文書 情報が簡潔に記されている 　 　封印された霊気流を見つけたら 　付近に石積みを探せ 　それを崩せば、封印は解ける
messages.text: 霊気流の封印をランダム化

messages.name: EldenForm_springsealsL
messages.explanation: Further explanation for springseals option
messages.english_text: Each stone stack unseals a random spiritspring
messages.text: 石積みを崩したときにランダムな霊気流の封印が解かれます

messages.name: EldenForm_status
messages.explanation: Default status bar text. {0} is replaced with credits sentence, and {1} is replaced by a number called the config hash. This is a 5-digit number which depends on the exact set of options the user has enabled.
messages.text: {0} 現在の設定ハッシュ: {1}

messages.name: EldenForm_status_credits
messages.explanation: Mod creation credits, {0} is the developer username
messages.text: 作成者 - {0}

messages.explanation: Mod creation credits including translators, {0} is the developer username and {1} comes from the 'translators' field

messages.name: EldenForm_swapboss
messages.explanation: When checked, randomized multi-boss fights can have different types of bosses. For instance, instead of two Crystalians, you might get a Crystalian and a Watchdog.
messages.text: 複数ボス戦でそれぞれの敵をすべての複数ボスからランダムに選ぶ

messages.name: EldenForm_swapbossL
messages.explanation: Clarification to swapboss option that it only works for mini-dungeon (caves, catacombs, etc.) bosses
messages.text: (ミニダンジョンのボス限定)

messages.name: EldenForm_swaprewards
messages.explanation: When bosses are randomized, changes their rune drop amounts. For instance, if Malenia is in Margit's arena, her runes will be based on her original amount but scaled down from Malenia's level to Margit's level
messages.english_text: Change boss runes to correspond to the original boss
messages.text: ボスから獲得できるルーンの量を元の配置ボスに合わせる

messages.name: EldenForm_swaprewards
messages.explanation: When bosses are randomized, changes their rune drop amounts. When this is unchecked, Margit will always drop 12000 runes. When this is checked, and Malenia is in Margit's arena, the runes will be based on her original amount, but possibly scaled down from Malenia's level to Margit's level. This option's phrasing was changed in v0.9 to be less ambiguous.
messages.english_text: Change boss runes when the boss changes
messages.text: 置き換えられたボスのルーン量を増減させる

messages.name: EldenForm_tarnished
messages.explanation: Checkbox in the DLC tab to enable randomizing the Tarnished Pack DLC
messages.text: Tarnished Pack

messages.name: EldenForm_toggleDarkModeToolStripMenuItem
messages.explanation: Menu option to enable or disable dark mode as the visual theme
messages.text: ダークモードの切り替え

messages.name: EldenForm_updateButton
messages.explanation: Button which opens the randomizer files page, to allow easy checks for newer versions of the randomizer
messages.text: 更新をチェック

messages.name: EldenForm_updateToolStripMenuItem
messages.explanation: Menu option in the file menu in the top left. When clicked, this just opens a link to the randomizer's mod page
messages.english_text: Check for updates on Nexus Mods
messages.text: Nexus Mods を開く（アップデートを確認）

messages.name: EldenForm_upgradeExplainL
messages.explanation: Long explanation for how randomizing upgrade material Bell Bearings work (for Smithing Stones, Somber Smithing Stones, Grave Glovewort, and Ghost Glovewort). See mod page for more details
messages.english_text: If randomized, Smithing Stone and Glovewort Bell Bearings are placed in the same overall area as their vanilla location. Their contents are not randomized.
messages.text: ランダム化した場合でも、鍛石・すずらんの鈴玉は元と同じエリア内に配置されます。売り物はランダム化されません。

messages.name: EldenForm_upgradeGroup
messages.explanation: Label asking how to randomize Bell Bearings with upgrade materials, like Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]
messages.text: 鈴玉のランダム化

messages.name: EldenForm_uxm
messages.explanation: Checkbox to write randomized files to UXM. If unchecked, it assumes Mod Engine installation
messages.text: ファイルを UXM 用に出力

messages.name: EldenForm_uxm
messages.explanation: Checkbox to write randomized files to Nuxe (previously UXM) in misc options. If unchecked, it assumes Mod Engine installation
messages.text: Nuxe 用に出力する

messages.name: EldenForm_uxmL
messages.explanation: Further description for Nuxe file output which has a disclaimer from installation instructions. The issues can arise without Nuxe too, so there are further instructions to go use 'Verify integrity of game files' under 'Installed Files' in the game's properties in Steam
messages.english_text: Installing the randomizer with Nuxe can lead to long or infinite loading screens. If you get long loading screens without Nuxe, verify integrity of installed files in Steam.
messages.text: Nuxe で Randomizer をインストールした場合、ロード時間が長くなったり、無限ロードが発生することがあります。Nuxe を使用していないのにロードが長引く場合は、Steam の「ゲームファイルの整合性を確認」を実行してください。

messages.name: EldenForm_versionMismatch
messages.explanation: Yes/no confirmation prompt when loading an options file. {0} and {1} are the randomizer version names, like v0.1. The different output refers to how the same set of randomizer options, at different versions of the randomizer, may result in different item/enemy placements.
messages.english_text: Mismatched options versions! File has version {0}, but current randomizer version is {1}. This may result in different output. Try to continue anyway?
messages.text: 各オプションのバージョンが一致していません！ファイル側のバージョンは {0} ですが、Randomizer のバージョンは {1} です。よって異なる結果になる可能性があります。無視して続行しますか？

messages.name: EldenForm_weaponprogression

messages.text: 統合されている Mod ディレクトリを Zip ファイルとして圧縮します。

messages.name: EldenForm_zipModFilesToolStripMenuItem
messages.explanation: Action in the file menu to save a zip file with all of the randomized mod files, mainly for distributing mod files for Seamless Co-op
messages.text: Mod のファイルを圧縮...

messages.english_text: Special configuration to adjust the frequency of enemies relative to others of the same type
messages.text: 敵の出現頻度を調整できます。たとえば元が 5% の敵なら、50% に調整すると 2.5% の確率で出現するようになります

messages.name: EnemyClass_Basic
messages.explanation: Enemy category for most of the normal non-boss enemies encountered in the game
messages.text: 雑魚敵

messages.explanation: Explanation for Regular Enemies when customizing enemies
messages.english_text: Enemies not covered by other categories
messages.text: 他のカテゴリで扱われていない敵

messages.explanation: Explanation for Hostile Humans. Notably it includes NPCs like Millicent and Sellen, because they appear multiple times in different locations, and it would be confusing to randomize them.
messages.english_text: Invaders and hostile NPCs without extensive quests
messages.text: 侵入者または長めのクエストがない敵対 NPC

messages.name: EnemyClass_Miniboss
messages.explanation: Enemy category for enemies with boss healthbars wandering the game world, not covered by other miniboss categories
messages.text: フィールド中ボス

messages.name: EnemyClass_MinibossDesc
messages.explanation: Explanation for World Minibosses

messages.text: フィールドでボス用の HP ゲージが表示される敵

messages.name: EnemyClass_MinorBoss
messages.explanation: Enemy category for boss encounters, usually with fog gates, including those in side dungeons (mini-dungeons)
messages.text: 中ボス

messages.name: EnemyClass_MinorBossDesc
messages.explanation: Explanation for Minor Bosses. Compare with the explanation for Major Bosses
messages.english_text: Other unescapable boss encounters, including side dungeon bosses
messages.text: その他の逃亡不可ボス（ミニダンジョンのボスなど）

messages.name: EnemyClass_NightMiniboss
messages.explanation: Enemy category for minibosses which roam the world at night
messages.text: 夜の中ボス

messages.name: EnemyClass_NightMinibossDesc
messages.explanation: Explanation for Night Minibosses

messages.explanation: RandomizerHelper option when auto-equip is enabled, to auto-equip sorceries and incantations when they are acquired
messages.text: 術を自動装備

messages.name: HelperOptions_equipWeapons
messages.explanation: RandomizerOption when auto-equip is enabled, to auto-equip weapons and shields when they are acquired
messages.text: 武器を自動装備

messages.name: HelperOptions_regionLockWeapons
messages.explanation: RandomizerOption when auto-upgrade weapons is enabled. Even if the player's max weapon level is +25, if they get a weapon in Limgrave, it will only be upgraded to +3, the max level for the region
messages.english_text: Limit max auto-upgrade level based on the region where the weapon is acquired
messages.text: 武器の取得場所に応じて強化の最大段階を制限する（序盤になるほど低強化）

messages.name: HelperOptions_weaponLevelRange
messages.explanation: RandomizerOption when auto-upgrade weapons is enabled, for a textbox to choose a weapon level from 0 to 25. It describes how an example upgrade level is modified randomly
messages.english_text: Nerf auto-upgrade by reducing weapons' levels by a random amount. If set to 3, an auto-upgrade level of +10 (+4 somber) gives a +8 +9 or +10 weapon (+3 or +4 somber)
messages.text: この数値だけ武器の自動強化値をランダムに下げます。例: 3に設定しているときに自動強化値が+10（喪色で+4）なら、実際の強化値は+8から+10（喪色なら+3か+4）となります。

messages.name: HelperOptions_weaponLevelsBelowMax
messages.explanation: RandomizerOption when auto-upgrade weapons is enabled, for a textbox to choose a weapon level from 0 to 25. It describes how an example upgrade level is modified by a fixed amount
messages.english_text: Nerf auto-upgrade by reducing weapons' levels by a fixed amount. If set to 3, an auto-upgrade level of +20 (+8 somber) gives a +17 weapon (+7 somber)
messages.text: この数値だけ武器の自動強化値を下げます。例: 3に設定しているときに自動強化値が+20（喪色で+8）なら、実際の強化値は+17（喪色なら+7）となります。

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeDesc_AreaSilo
messages.explanation: Tab name for area-based silos in custom item placement, which currently allows randomizing the base game and DLC separately for some types of items. See an explanation for silos overall under TabTypeDesc_Silos.
messages.text: DLC の配置割り

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeDesc_Bias
messages.explanation: Tab name for bias controls in custom item placement, same as EldenForm_biasGroup
messages.text: バイアス

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeDesc_ItemShards
messages.explanation: Tab name for splitting up key items into shards in custom item placement.
messages.text: キーアイテムの欠片

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeDesc_Overview
messages.explanation: Tab name for the default tab in custom item placement which has top-level controls and a summary of other configuration options
messages.text: 概要

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeDesc_PremiumGroups
messages.explanation: Tab name for the top-level tab for premium locations, containing an explanation of how they work and a button to add a custom rule. This is a mechanism for requiring a set of locations to pick from a set of selected items and no other items. This is usually to ensure these locations always have good rewards, which is why they're called premium, though it doesn't have to be used for that.
messages.text: 目ぼしい場所

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeDesc_SharedOptions
messages.explanation: Tab name for options in custom item placement which don't correspond to any placement rules, which can be the same as EldenForm_miscPage, though it is not capitalized here
messages.text: その他のオプション

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeDesc_Silos
messages.explanation: Tab name for the top-level tab in item placement for configuring both area silos and item silos, which contains an explanation and a button to add a new item silo. A silo is an isolated group of items/locations which are randomized among themselves. An item silo specifically has a list of items, and whatever items are defined there can only replace each other. A silo can be also called a partition, division, etc.
messages.text: 配置割り

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeExplain_AreaSilo
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for the DLC silos tab in custom item placement. This references other settings in the DLC tab, where if those settings are used, the custom item placement settings will be ignored. Normally items are placed in silos based on their original location, but BaseOnlyItems and DlcOnlyItems allows switching an item's DLC silo (not allowed for major key items)
messages.english_text: DLC silos allow randomizing base game and DLC items separately. Note that selecting "Randomize base game and DLC separately" in the DLC tab or disabling the DLC tab altogether takes priority over these settings. You can override the DLC silo for non-key items with item placement rules.
messages.text: DLC の配置割りでは、本編と DLC のアイテムを分けてランダム化できます。なお、DLC タブで "DLC と本編を分けてランダム化" を選んでいる場合や、DLC タブ自体を無効にしている場合は、そちらの設定が優先されます。キーアイテムを含まない DLC の配置割りはアイテム配置ルールで上書きできます。

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeExplain_ItemShards
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for key item shards tab in custom item placement. This contains shared text with EldenForm_logicItemDlcInfoL, and recommends using the moremaxslots option in that case.
messages.english_text: When key items are split into shards, you need to acquire shards to use the key. Randomization may fail if there are too many shards and too few key item locations. If that happens, consider allowing multiple key items per location in the Logic tab. If you set 0 required shards, the item is no longer needed.
messages.text: 欠片に分割すると、キーアイテムを使用するにはその欠片をすべて集めなければなりません。欠片が多すぎる、かつキーアイテムの配置先が少なすぎる場合、ランダム化に失敗してしまう恐れがあります。そのような場合は Rules タブで、一つの配置先に複数のキーアイテムを配置可能にするといいでしょう。必要数を 0 にした場合、そのアイテムは不要になります。

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeExplain_ItemSilo
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for an item silo tab in custom item placement, which can be seen only by adding a custom item silo. A few things here: this contains an explation for ItemSiloType modes, then an explanation for possible failure cases. It references the copydrops setting as causing failures sometimes. A junk item is a low-value item that's unrelated to the silo, replacing a different item in the silo because *something* has to go there.
messages.english_text: Within item silos, individual items replace each other. By-type groups add many smaller silos for every weapon type or armor slot in the game. Normally all items are both sources and targets, but randomization will fail if there are more sources than targets in a silo, which can happen with the option to add guaranteed copies of random enemy drops. If there are more targets than sources, junk items may replace some target items. If items or item locations in a silo have placement restrictions, randomization may fail.
messages.text: アイテム配置割りの中では、個々のアイテムが互いに入れ替わります。種類別グループを選ぶと、ゲーム内のすべての武器種・防具スロットごとに、小さな配置割りがたくさん追加されます。通常、すべてのアイテムは配置元かつ配置先となりますが、1つの配置割りにおいて配置元が配置先より多いとランダム化に失敗してしまいます。これは、敵のランダムドロップを確定入手アイテムとして追加するオプションによって発生し得ます。逆に配置先が配置元より多い場合、一部の配置先にゴミアイテムが置かれることがあります。配置割り内のアイテムや置き場所に配置制限がある場合も、ランダム化に失敗することがあります。

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeExplain_Overview
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for custom item placement in the default Overview tab. This references the left sidebar which allows switching to different settings to configure, some of which are rules which are applied during randomization. Some settings are arranged in a hierarchy or tree, so this also points out that you can click on those to configure settings and add new rules. This text has some overlap with EldenForm_customitemHelp.
messages.english_text: Custom item placement is an advanced mode for detailed configuration of items and locations. Settings configured in custom item placement won't apply anymore if it's disabled. Select any category on the left to configure placement rules. In some cases, you can add new custom rules under root categories.
messages.text: アイテム配置カスタマイズは、アイテムとその配置先を細かく決めることができる詳細モードです。チェックを外して無効にすると、ここで設定した内容は適用されなくなります。左側のカテゴリから配置ルールを設定できます。一部のカテゴリでは、親カテゴリの下に新しいカスタムルールを追加できます。

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeExplain_Placements
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for the top-level 'Item placements' tab in custom item placement. This is mainly a summary of other item placement text, but talks about interactions between different placement rules or placement groups. 'All constraints' for an item can refer to settings that an item must be placed somewhere or cannot be placed there. 'Region constraints' are additional constraints added by randomizer logic, like enforcing that enough Sacred Tears are available before Leyndell or that a particular key item must be placed in a particular dungeon.
messages.english_text: Item placement rules control where individual items can or cannot be placed. If an item is configured in multiple rules, all constraints apply to it at once. It is easily possible to create impossible combinations of rules where there are not enough locations to fit the items, or vice versa, especially if items have separate region constraints. In those cases, the rules may be ignored or cause randomization failures.
messages.text: 個々のアイテムをどこに配置可/不可にするかのルールです。あるアイテムが複数のルールで定義されている場合、すべての制限が同時に適用されます。とりわけアイテムに個別の地域制限がある場合、それらのアイテムに対して配置先が足りない（あるいはその逆）といった、実現不可能なルールの組み合わせが容易に生じてしまいます。このような場合、ルールが無視されたり、ランダム化に失敗する原因となるでしょう。

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeExplain_PremiumGroups
messages.explanation: Very detailed explanation for the top-level 'Premium groups' tab in custom item placement. Unlike item placements which can add constraints for which locations an item must appear in, premium locations add constraints for which items a location must have. The last part of this talks about the interaction between item placement rules and premium location rules.
messages.english_text: Premium location rules control which items can be placed in particular locations. Ideally there are many more items than locations per rule. If a location is configured in multiple rules, the only allowed items come from the intersection of those rules. If this leaves no valid items for a location, the rule is ignored and a warning is added to spoiler logs. If there are not enough items for a location, the rules may be ignored. Note that item placement rules take priority over premium locations, so any items which can only appear at specific locations can always be placed there. If an item is already forbidden from appearing in a location, like unmissable items in missable locations or farmable items in guaranteed locations, putting it in a premium rule won't change that.
messages.text: 特別なポイントにどのアイテムを配置させるかのルールです。1つのルールごとに、場所の数よりもアイテムの数が沢山あると理想的です。同じ場所が複数のルールで定義されている場合、配置されるのは互いのルールで共通しているアイテムのみとなります。それによって有効なアイテムが1つも残らなかった場合、ルールは無視され、spoiler_logs に警告が出力されます。場所に対してアイテムが足りない場合も、ルールが無視されることがあります。なお、アイテム配置ルールはこのルールよりも優先されるため、特定の場所にしか配置されないアイテムは必ずそこに配置されます。ある場所への配置がすでに禁止されているアイテムについて、たとえば取り逃し可能な場所に配置させた必須アイテムや、確定入手できる場所に配置させた繰り返し入手アイテムは、このルールに追加しても禁止されたままです。

messages.name: ItemPanel_TabTypeExplain_Silos
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for the top-level Silos tab in custom item placement, which summarizes DLC silos and item silos and their interaction. See LocationGroup_enemyinf for the main use of farmable enemy drops as a location category.
messages.english_text: Silos change which groups of locations are randomized among themselves. Note some locations are always randomized separately, like item pickups and farmable enemy drops. Within that, locations can be further split up by region with DLC silos. At the same time, locations can be split up based on groups of items. If an item is configured in multiple item silos, it is added to the first applicable silo only.
messages.text: 配置割り（Silo）は、どの場所グループを相互にランダム化するのかを決める仕組みです（アイテムを拾える場所・繰り返し入手できる敵ドロップのように、常に独立してランダム化される場所もあります）。その枠組みの中で、DLC の配置割りによってさらに地域単位で分けることができます。また、アイテムのグループに基づいて分けることも可能です。もしも1つのアイテムが複数のアイテム配置割りで定義されている場合、最初に該当した配置割りにのみ追加されます。

messages.name: ItemPreset_AreaSiloType_DLC
messages.explanation: Option in custom item placement. When selected, base game items are only placed in the base game, and DLC items are only placed in the DLC
messages.text: 本編と DLC で分ける

messages.name: ItemPreset_AreaSiloType_None
messages.explanation: Option in custom item placement. When selected, there is no separation between items from different sources
messages.text: 無効

messages.name: ItemPreset_biasItemSpread
messages.explanation: Label for a number in the Bias tab in custom item placement which goes from 0 to 15. The thing being spread is the probability range of desirable items being placed in difficult locations, and the higher it is, the more the probability is skewed.
messages.text: アイテムの分散値

messages.name: ItemPreset_biasItemSpreadHelp
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for item spread which appears as a tooltip for the question mark icon. The expression 2^spread is exponentiation where spread is the number being configured, so this is basically a logarithmic setting. This setting does not apply to key items or important items, only to normal items. Key item spread is the version of this which applies to key items.
messages.english_text: Item spread defines the weight of the most difficult and late location in the game, for placing normal items. The lowest location weight is 1 and highest weight is 2^spread, and other weights are gradually spaced in between them. If this is 0, all locations have the same weight. If it's 1, the most desirable location is at most twice as likely for whichever item is eligible to go there first.
messages.text: 通常アイテムの配置における、ゲーム内で最も難しくなる後半ロケーションの重みを決めます。重みが最も低い場所は 1、最も高い場所は 2^分散値 となり、それ以外の重みはその間に段階的に割かれます。0 にすると、すべての場所が同じ重みになります。1 にした場合、最初にその場所へ配置可能となるアイテムにとって、最も望ましい場所が選ばれる確率は最大 2 倍になります。

messages.name: ItemPreset_biasKeyItemChainWeight
messages.explanation: Label for a number in the Bias tab in custom item placement which goes from 1 to 100. Key item chaining is when a key item is locked behind another key item which is locked behind another key item, and so on, also described in EldenForm_keyitem2.
messages.text: キーアイテムチェーンの重み

messages.name: ItemPreset_biasKeyItemChainWeightHelp
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for key item chain weight, or chain multiplier, which appears as a tooltip for the question mark icon. This is a fairly low-level explanation about the key item logic algorithm, where a group of locations (an area) can have special weights which get increased and decreased (multiplied and divided) as more key items are assigned.
messages.english_text: When assigning a major key item to an area, the desirability of areas blocked by the item is multiplied by the key item chain weight, leading to key item chains. The desirability for an area is also divided by this value when an item is placed there, cancelling out the chain multiplier and overall spreading out key items. For key item placement, an "area" is a group of locations which are mutually accessible without needing any key items.
messages.text: あるエリアに主要キーアイテムが割り当てられると、そのアイテムが鍵となるエリア群の選ばれやすさにこの値が乗算され、キーアイテムのチェーン（流れ）が構築されます。また、そのエリアにアイテムが配置されると、エリアの選ばれやすさがこの値で除算されるため、チェーンの乗数を打ち消し、全体としてキーアイテムを分散させることになります。キーアイテムの配置における「エリア」とは、キーアイテムを一切必要とせずに行き来できる場所の集まりのことです。

messages.name: ItemPreset_biasKeyItemRegionSpread
messages.explanation: Label for a number in the Bias tab in custom item placement which goes from 1 to 100. Unlike 'key item spread', which is a spread in location probabilities, this is literally spreading items across different game regions.
messages.text: キーアイテムの地域分散値

messages.name: ItemPreset_biasKeyItemRegionSpreadHelp
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for key item region spread which appears as a tooltip for the question mark icon. This has a lot of the same explanation as key item chain weight. The main new thing is an explanation that the two settings interact by stacking multiplicatively, which means that the weight for an area is divided by region spread times chain weight when both are set.
messages.english_text: Key item region spread is an alternative to chain weight which can spread out key items across areas without forcing chains. The weight for areas is divided by this value when an item is placed there. This stacks multiplicatively with chain weight if both are present. For key item placement, an "area" is a group of locations which are mutually accessible without needing any key items.
messages.text: チェーンの重みの代わりとなる設定値で、チェーンを強要することなくキーアイテムを各エリアに分散させることができます。アイテムが配置されると、そのエリアの重みはこの値で除算されます。チェーンの重みと両方設定されている場合は、乗算的に重なり合います。キーアイテムの配置における「エリア」とは、キーアイテムを一切必要とせずに行き来できる場所の集まりのことです。

messages.name: ItemPreset_biasKeyItemSpread
messages.explanation: Label for a number in the Bias tab in custom item placement which goes from 0 to 20, and is a companion to regular 'Item spread' weight except it applies to key items only
messages.text: キーアイテムの分散値

messages.name: ItemPreset_biasKeyItemSpreadHelp
messages.explanation: Detailed explanation for key item spread which appears as a tooltip for the question mark icon. It references 'Item spread' which applies to non-key items. The main important effect described is placing key items at bosses rather than item pickups.
messages.english_text: Key item spread defines the weight of the most difficult and late location in the game, for placing important items. It makes major key items more likely to be placed at bosses. It works the same way as normal item spread, but is usually higher because major key items are limited to specific areas by logic, and locations within specific areas have closer weights.
messages.text: 重要なアイテムの配置における、ゲーム内で最も難しくなる後半ロケーションの重みを決めます。この重みによって、主要キーアイテムがボス地点に配置されやすくなります。通常アイテムの分散と同じように働きますが、主要キーアイテムはロジック上特定エリアに限定され、特定エリア内のロケーションは重みの差が小さくなるため、通常はより高い値を指定します。

messages.name: ItemPreset_biasManual
messages.explanation: Checkbox in the Bias tab in custom item placement which changes whether the bias% slider is editable or the individual weights (e.g. item spread) are manually editable. If the slider is editable, the weights change automatically and are not editable individually. If the weights are editable, the bias% slider number is completely ignored.
messages.text: 個別に重みを設定

messages.name: ItemPreset_descEntry
messages.explanation: Entry in a description of an item preset. {0} is a type of item placement, {1} is the full description for it

messages.name: ItemPreset_descExclude
messages.explanation: In a description of custom item placement, {0} is a list of locations where certain items are excluded from appearing, like minidungeons or night bosses
messages.text: {0}を除外

messages.name: ItemPreset_descItemLine
messages.explanation: In a description of custom item placement, {0} is a list of items in a placement. The hyphen is indenting the previous lines, like a bulleted list.
messages.text: - アイテム: {0}

messages.name: ItemPreset_descLine
messages.explanation: In a description of custom item placement, this is a multi-purpose template for formatting a bulleted list. The hyphen is indenting the line, with one line per entry. {0} is replaced with the list entry, whatever it is.

messages.name: ItemPreset_descNone
messages.explanation: In a description of custom item placement, this text is shown when no items or locations are specified. This usually means the placement rule is not used.
messages.text: なし

messages.name: ItemPreset_descRequire
messages.explanation: In a description of custom item placement, {0} is a list of locations where certain items must appear, like important locations
messages.text: {0}に配置

messages.name: ItemPreset_descRequireExclude
messages.explanation: In a description of custom item placement, this is a combination of descRequire and descExclude. {0} is a list of locations where certain items must appear, and {1} is a list of locations where certain items may not appear
messages.text: {0}に配置 - {1}は除外

messages.name: ItemPreset_descRequireExcludeLoc
messages.explanation: Another variant of descRequireExclude which is used when the thing being described is a location, so 'Placed in' would be redundant

messages.name: ItemPreset_disable
messages.explanation: Label for checkbox shown in custom item placement rule, including premium groups and custom item silos. When checked, the rule does not apply during randomization, but it is kept around for later if needed. 'Core mechanics' is an example of a rule that can be disabled, but not all rules can be disabled.
messages.text: ルールを無効化

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemFilter_add
messages.explanation: Menu option in the dropdown menu for an item group in custom item placement, which changes the group to add a filter. For instance, after clicking 'Add filter: DLC' to 'Sorceries', the item group will change to 'Sorceries (DLC)'. You can see this in the 'Premium currency shop' tab by clicking one of the item groups
messages.text: フィルターを追加: {0}

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemFilter_clear
messages.explanation: Menu option in the dropdown menu for an item group with a filter. For instance, after adding a filter to make 'Sorceries (DLC)', click 'Clear filter' to change it back to 'Sorceries'. You can see this in the 'Premium currency shop' tab by clicking one of the item groups
messages.text: フィルターを解除

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemFilterGroup_dlc
messages.explanation: Filter name for an item group which selects only items which were added in the DLC. This is a filter because it changes an existing group like 'Weapons' to 'Weapons (DLC)', for instance
messages.text: DLC

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemFilterGroup_legendary
messages.explanation: Filter name for an item group which selects only items which have big golden shiny pickups on the ground. For example, 'Weapons (Legendary)' includes Eclipse Shotel and Starscourge Greatsword.
messages.text: 伝説

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemFilterGroup_nodlc
messages.explanation: Filter name for an item group which selects items which were *not* added in the DLC. For example, you can create a filtered group called 'Cookbooks (Base game)'
messages.text: 本編

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemFilterGroup_rare
messages.explanation: Filter name for an item group which selects only items which have purple shiny pickups on the ground. For example, 'Weapons (Rare)' includes Golden Halberd and Bloodhound's Fang
messages.text: レア

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemFilterGroupDesc
messages.explanation: This is the name of the filtered item group. {0} gets replaced by the item group name (see ItemGroup), and {1} gets replaced by the filter name (see ItemFilterGroup)

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemFilterMultiDesc
messages.explanation: This is the name of a filter group which contains multiple filters. {0} is the first filter and {1} is the second filter. So a filter for DLC legendary weapons will become 'DLC & Legendary' which then applies to an item group like 'Weapon (DLC & Legendary)'. Note this may end up supporting 3 or more filters in the future by getting chained together.

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_accessories
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all talismans
messages.text: タリスマン

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_arrows
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all arrow and bolt ammunition (矢／ボルト)
messages.text: 矢/ボルト

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_bosssouls
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all boss remembrances, like 串刺し公の追憶 and エルデの追憶
messages.text: 追憶

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_containers
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all crafting containers: Cracked Pots, Ritual Pots, Perfume Bottles, and Hefty Cracked Pots
messages.text: 製作用容器

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_cookbooks
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all cookbooks, like 宣教師の製法書【１】 and 調香師の製法書【２】
messages.text: 製法書

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_craftingmats
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all items used for crafting (アイテム製作素材)
messages.text: 製作素材

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_crystaltears
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all Crystal Tears (結晶雫)
messages.text: 結晶雫

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_gems
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all Ash of War items which can be equipped to weapons (戦灰)
messages.text: 戦灰

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_greatrunes
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all demi-god Great Runes (大ルーン)
messages.text: 大ルーン

messages.name: ItemPreset_ItemGroup_incantations
messages.explanation: Custom item group consisting of all incantations

messages.name: PresetEditForm_customHelpText
messages.explanation: Long explanation for using the custom enemy editor which can be accessed by clicking on the '?' link in a particular enemy category. This refers to other parts of the UI which have their own entries. Please ask me if you'd like further explanation for any of this, since this text tries to communicate how the randomizer works internally, which is complicated, and how to configure it, which is also complicated.
messages.english_text:
Enemy randomizer works by swapping out enemies with other enemies taken from elsewhere in the game. It does this independently for each enemy category. Here you can configure a custom list of source enemies which can replace enemies in this category. You can also merge some categories together, by selecting "Merge with" in subcategories, or clicking on "Quick edit" links below to do this automatically.

When configuring source enemies, you can click the + button to add a new source group. The % probability across all groups in a category must add up to 100%. If you want 10% of enemies in this category to become any boss, use a 90% group with "Same category" and a 10% group with "All Bosses". If you want only 50% of enemies in this category to be randomized, use a 50% group with "Same category" and a 50% group with "Not randomized".
messages.text:
Enemy randomizer はゲームのある地点に配置された敵を、別の地点にいる敵と入れ替えることで敵をランダム化しています。ランダム化は敵のカテゴリごとに行われ、この画面では各カテゴリにおける敵のリストを設定できます。なお、カテゴリの設定から "統合する" を選べば、別々のカテゴリを一つにまとめることも可能です（下段のクイック編集を押すだけでも統合できます）。

+ ボタンを押すと、リストに敵のグループを追加できます。グループにはそれぞれ確率を設定でき、選ばれたグループに含まれるいずれかの敵が実際に出現することになります。各グループの確率は合計 100% になるよう設定します。たとえば 10% の確率でボスを選ばせたいなら、90% の確率で "同カテゴリ" の敵が選ばれるグループを追加し、10% の確率で "すべてのボス" が選ばれるグループを追加するといいでしょう。あるいは 50% の確率でランダム化させないようにしたいなら、50% の確率で "同カテゴリ" の敵が選ばれるグループを追加し、50% の確率で "ランダム化しない" が選ばれるグループを追加してあげましょう。
